reason: Bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomisation on published GWAS summary statistics for epigenetic clocks, a summary-data design not among the five eligible designs.
Secondary analysis of individual-level CAN-BIND-1 trial data measuring ECS-gene DNA methylation in 178 patients in relation to antidepressant treatment outcome.

Uses individual-level cord blood DNA methylation measured in the ABIS birth cohort, linked to later type 1 diabetes risk stratification, though the paper is largely a network re-analysis of previously reported profiles.
CHAF1A was assayed as mRNA expression and by protein immunohistochemistry; no DNA methylation, histone mark or chromatin state was measured despite the chromatin-related gene name.
Biological age acceleration was computed by the Klemera-Doubal method from 11 clinical biomarkers, not from any DNA methylation or other epigenetic measurement.

Urine DNA methylation of PENK and NKPD1 measured in a 606-sample case-control cohort for bladder cancer detection and post-operative surveillance, although the paper is also framed as assay development.
Epigenome-wide blood DNA methylation measured in 536 cohort participants and related to ambient PM2.5, a modifiable environmental exposure.
SOX11 methylation quantified in circulating tumour DNA of 353 colon cancer patients and related to recurrence-free survival, a prognostic decision.
Citrullinated histone H3 was measured in serum as a circulating NET protein biomarker, which the instrument classifies as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Prognostic model built by in-silico re-analysis of existing cBioPortal and registry mutation databases, and no epigenetic marker was measured.
IFI44L promoter methylation quantified in 566 participants in a cross-sectional study evaluating diagnosis, disease activity and treatment monitoring in SLE.
Promoter methylation of 12 HRR genes measured by pyrosequencing in 96 HGSOC patients to predict PARP inhibitor response and progression-free survival.

Epigenetic clock measures were assayed in CARDIA cohort participants and compared by sexual and gender minority status, but whether stigma and structural discrimination count as a modifiable exposure under criterion 4 is a judgement call.
RASSF1A and SHOX2 methylation measured in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid from 310 prospectively enrolled, randomised patients for early lung cancer diagnosis.
PhenoAge and KDM biological age were derived from clinical blood biomarkers in UK Biobank, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic marker measured.
Genome-wide DNA methylation measured at admission in 75 hospitalised COVID-19 patients and related to subsequent respiratory severity trajectory, a prognostic use.
Mechanistic laboratory study in cell lines and xenograft mice combined with in-silico TCGA re-analysis; the design is not one of the five eligible human study designs.
ChIP-seq was done in TK6 cells and mice, while the benzene-exposed worker cohort had only ATF3 and ALOX12 expression and oxidative-stress biochemistry measured, so no human epigenetic marker.
Global DNA methylation and Levine epigenetic age acceleration measured in over 1,500 Women's Health Initiative participants and linked to social determinants and incident hypertension.
TP53 mutations located at CpG dinucleotides are DNA sequence variants, not methylation or any other measured epigenetic mark.
Methylated ctDNA loci (HOXA9, TFAP2B, MCIDAS, SP9) measured by ddPCR in 68 NSCLC patients to predict relapse after curative radiotherapy.
Descriptive molecular-profiling series of 106 penile carcinoma cases screening GPS1 exon 9 mutations, with no comparison group and no epigenetic marker.
The human case-control component measured serum contaminants only; chromatin remodelling appeared solely as a pathway label in proteomics of exposed A549 cells.
MGMT promoter methylation status measured in 153 recurrent glioblastoma patients and used to inform extent-of-resection surgical decision-making.
Histone H4K5 and H4K12 acetylation was measured only in APP/PS1 mice, while the human NHANES and Mendelian randomisation components measured no epigenetic marker.

Patient cohorts were profiled for PDIA6 protein and immune infiltrate, with chromatin immunoprecipitation of KRAS and YY1 done in cell lines, so no eligible epigenetic marker was measured in human participants.
Retrospective cohort measured only serum inflammatory proteins (HBP, PCT, CRP, SAA) with no epigenetic marker of any kind.
The 80 paired human tissues were assayed for SLC31A1 expression only, with ChIP restricted to transcription-factor binding in breast cancer cell lines.
Retrospective series of 14 PLNTY cases with no comparison group, which the instrument classes as not_primary ahead of the language criterion.
EPIC-array DNA methylation measured in 64 childhood-onset lupus patients versus 47 controls and related to disease activity and diagnostic subgrouping.
Spine age was estimated by deep learning from DXA vertebral fracture assessment images, not from any epigenetic measurement.
BDNF DNA methylation measured by pyrosequencing in a prospective cohort of 294 injured children and compared between traumatic brain injury and orthopaedic injury.
Two-sample Mendelian randomisation using genetic summary statistics for epigenetic clocks and lifespan, a summary-data design not among the five eligible designs.
Whole-blood 850k DNA methylation and epigenetic clocks measured in 272 MASLD-HCC cases and 316 controls for hepatocellular carcinoma risk stratification.
Nasopharyngeal DNA methylation arrays measured in a case-control study of hospitalised COVID-19 patients versus healthy controls, linking a preventable infection exposure to methylation.
PhenoAge and PhenoAgeAccel in NHANES were derived from clinical chemistry biomarkers, not from DNA methylation.
Methylated ctDNA markers HOXD8 and POU4F1 measured by ddPCR in a 71-patient cohort, though the clinical decision link is indirect via tumour burden quantification for prognosis and monitoring.
The outcome was the sperm DNA fragmentation index, which the instrument explicitly excludes as a chromatin integrity test rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Only serum autoantibodies were assayed, including anti-histone antibodies, which are not a measurement of histone modification or chromatin state.
DNA methylation age acceleration measures were assayed in 3,840 Health and Retirement Study participants and tested as a mediator between BMI, a modifiable exposure, and survival.
Weathering was operationalised as Klemera-Doubal biological age from nine clinical biomarkers, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Methylation-based ctDNA tumour fraction measured serially in 627 patients on immune checkpoint inhibitors to monitor treatment response.
The 268-patient cohort was classified by next-generation sequencing mutations only; hypomethylating agent exposure was not accompanied by any measured epigenetic marker.
Ten DNA methylation clocks and DunedinPACE measured in 1,671 Berlin Aging Study II participants and used to predict incident metabolic syndrome.
Hypermethylated ctDNA measured by ddPCR in the METASARC and NEOSARC patient cohorts for prognostication and treatment monitoring, although the paper is substantially assay development.
Randomised cross-over human trial of plasmapheresis with epigenetic clocks measured before and after the intervention.
Summary-data Mendelian randomisation and colocalisation on published mQTL, eQTL and GWAS summary statistics, a design not among the five eligible ones.
Cross-sectional study of 113 chromium-exposed workers and 72 controls with blood DNA methylation of F2RL3, LINE-1, MGMT and SEMA4B measured against occupational exposure.
Blood DNA methylation clocks measured in 2,346 NHANES adults and related to folate, B12 and homocysteine, modifiable nutritional exposures.
DNA methylation age acceleration measures assayed in 3,566 Dongfeng-Tongji participants and related to sleep patterns, a modifiable behavioural exposure.
